Every time you point a finger, three point back at you.

Kevin Trudeau says we always blame the other person and always want them to change. His answer is blunt: no, change yourself.

He says spiritual texts around the world, thousands of years old, share the same phrase: as within, so without. The world you see is a reflection of your inner state.

What would change if you stopped waiting for someone else to change first?
